method.capture: Real native Play Mode frames, actual timestamps, unchanged fixed gameplay camera, complete scenery. No time override or synthesized temporal frames.
method.presence: Fixed rectangular ROIs; count pixels satisfying B-R>.047 and G-R>.047 in normalized RGB. Presence is not artistic acceptance.
method.tracking: Read-only grayscale local normalized cross-correlation of 15x31 pixel patches in each adjacent pair. Search image displacement s=-16..16px at0.25px steps along manually estimated local projected flow tangent (tx*s,s), bilinear resampling. Positive screen Y is downward.
method.classification: Best shift>.75px: downward; <-.75px: upward; otherwise subpixel/static.
limitations: Manual image-space ROIs/tangents; no new independent physical projection or carrier identity certification.
This supporting diagnostic does not apply the more elaborate older distinct-peak/visibility gates and is not a substitute for visual review.
A local subpixel/static result does not mean the entire waterfall stopped.
No phone frame-time, thermal, GPU cost, or target-device performance certification.

warmup.bad_first_attempt_observation: Both falls absent only in first render submission; subsequent23frames contain both. Fixed2-draw warmup prevented this artifact in reviewed final48frames; asynchronous variant readiness was not independently logged.
